events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations and wait for centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo $DB; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t061v/state --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tail -3; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:18890/admin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^[23]" && break; sleep 2; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:18890/admin/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:18892/__state
